text:
Sam - Product: @channel heads-up: new Private On‑Prem Backup & Restore SLA + Offline Support playbook. Effective 2026-10-01. Short version: nightly incremental snapshots by default, customer-configurable retention (30/90/365 days), encrypted at rest with either Redwood-managed regional KMS or customer HSM, and an RTO commitment for Tiered restores (Critical: 8h, Standard: 48h). Remote restore assistance requires an attestation key (vendor-signed image or HSM handshake). Please see action items below.

Ivy - Eng-Infra: question: how do we surface retention choices at provisioning?

Sam - Product: add `--backup-retention=[30|90|365]` on create and default to 90. We'll include a dry-run restore test command in the CLI.

Hugo - Eng-SRE: will need a restore-runner + bandwidth throttles. Also add a quarantine step for restores that reintroduce data from higher-privilege regions.

Mira - Legal: we'll add SLA language and a limited liability clause for restore failures caused by customer-supplied HSM misconfigurations. I'll draft addendum.

Alec - Customer Success: CS wants a readiness checklist and a 2-week verification for high-touch customers. We'll offer a one-time free test restore during onboarding.

Tess.sales: flagging: need SKU for the Backup & Restore SLA and optional HSM support add-on.

deploy-bot: feature flag "onprem.backup_restore_sla_v1" enabled in staging at 2026-06-02T17:05Z.

ops-bot: metric added: `onprem.backup.success_rate` and `onprem.restore.avg_rto`. Default telemetry off for Private clusters; customers must opt in to send restore diagnostics.

Sam - Product: Action owners + due dates:
- Eng-Infra (Ivy) -> CLI flag + snapshot scheduler + restore-runner -> due 2026-07-15
- Eng-SRE (Hugo) -> throttles, quarantine logic, runbooks -> due 2026-07-22
- Legal (Mira) -> SLA addendum + test-restore consent -> due 2026-06-25
- CS (Alec) -> verification checklist + onboarding offer -> due 2026-07-01
- Sales (tess.sales) -> SKU + enablement -> due 2026-06-30

Sam - Product: We'll cover this in the Private product sync tomorrow 10am PT. DM me for blockers. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
